description: This is a Java unit test class for testing the MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection class within a MongoDB persistence utility module. It contains tests for immutability, equality, collection name retrieval, filter retrieval, and string representations.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionTest
classes.description: Unit test for the MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection class, validating behaviors like immutability, equality, and filter handling.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static filter documents before all tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented.

methods.name: getCollectionNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getCollectionName returns the correct collection name.

methods.name: getFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that getFilter returns the expected filter object.

methods.name: emptyFilterIsEntireCollection
methods.description: Verifies that an empty filter signifies the entire collection.

methods.name: nonEmptyFilterIsNotEntireCollection
methods.description: Verifies that a non-empty filter does not correspond to the entire collection.

methods.name: toStringOfSelectionWithFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the string representation when a filter is applied.

methods.name: toStringOfSelectionWithoutFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the string representation when no filter is applied.
